description: Weekly dependency updates, one grouped pull request per ecosystem. Every pull request carries `technical`, its area and `no-changelog` (the household sees none of it, .claude/CLAUDE.md) and runs the whole of ci.yml before it is merged.

packageRules.description: openapi-typescript and typescript-eslint use the TypeScript JS API, which TypeScript 7 no longer has; the type check already runs TypeScript 7 as typescript-native. Lift once both support it.

A Postgres major cannot read the previous major's data: it needs pg_upgrade or a dump and restore of the household's database, and the image's volume path changes with 18. Done by hand, with that migration.
